title: Privileged sign-in from unfamiliar device
summary: A privileged service identity authenticated from a device and network not previously associated with this account. An endpoint telemetry gap prevents full validation.

signals.label: New device on privileged account
signals.detail: Identity sign-in record flags a device not previously registered for this principal.

signals.label: Unusual source network
signals.detail: Risk event marks the network location as unfamiliar. The address is reserved for documentation.

signals.label: Sensitive application accessed
signals.detail: Audit record shows access to a finance administration application after authentication.

signals.label: Elevated business impact
signals.detail: The asset is labeled critical in this synthetic environment. Impact is inferred, not observed compromise.

events.summary: Successful privileged sign-in from new device

next_steps: Verify sign-in ownership with the identity administrator using an approved channel.
Retrieve endpoint/MDM telemetry for the unfamiliar device.
Review session activity and privileged changes after sign-in.
If compromise is substantiated, escalate to incident response for approved containment.
rationale: Privileged access, new device, and subsequent sensitive application use warrant escalation. Missing endpoint telemetry remains unresolved.

title: OAuth application granted broad permissions
summary: A newly registered third-party OAuth app received mail read permissions, followed by token issuance. No owner approval record is present in the demo evidence.

signals.label: New / unrecognized app
signals.detail: App is unlisted in the synthetic approved catalog.

signals.label: Access token issued
signals.detail: Token event confirms the app can attempt delegated access; use of the token has not been confirmed.

next_steps: Validate app publisher, consent purpose, and the business owner.
Review API audit logs for mail reads or bulk access.
If unauthorized, escalate and request approved consent revocation.
rationale: Permission scope is sensitive, but actual data access is not established. Verify owner approval and mail API usage.

title: Periodic DNS beacon after script execution
summary: A workstation began periodic DNS queries to a newly observed domain following an unusual script process. Destination reputation is unknown.

signals.label: Highly regular query intervals
signals.detail: DNS logs show multiple near-uniform request intervals; this pattern is not proof of command-and-control.

signals.label: Unexpected script parentage
signals.detail: A script host was launched from a temporary directory.

signals.label: New domain in environment
signals.detail: DNS inventory first-seen value matches this alert window.

events.summary: Domain first observed in this lab dataset

next_steps: Review process lineage and script content in the approved EDR tool.
Check DNS and proxy activity for related hosts and outbound connections.
Enrich destination reputation from trusted threat intelligence.
Escalate for IR review before any containment decision.
rationale: Process and DNS timing correlation is concerning. Confirm the destination and process chain before assigning malware attribution.

title: Burst of failed MFA challenges
summary: An employee experienced rapid repeated MFA prompts followed by no successful authentication. Check whether the activity is expected before escalating.

signals.label: Unfamiliar client address
signals.detail: Sign-in risk engine reported unfamiliar source address.

signals.label: Rapid burst pattern
signals.detail: Temporal clustering is consistent with push fatigue but does not establish account takeover.

events.summary: No successful sign-in in review window

next_steps: Confirm whether the user initiated sign-in attempts.
Check for additional MFA denials and any eventual successful sign-in.
Escalate if user reports unexpected prompts or signs of account compromise.
rationale: Multiple denied MFA prompts can indicate abuse. No successful sign-in is visible, so gather user confirmation.

title: Approved vulnerability scanner activity
summary: Network telemetry matches an approved scanner window and registered scanning host. Validate the change ticket before closing.

signals.label: Scanner pattern observed
signals.detail: Port-probing traffic observed; source is registered as a scanner.

next_steps: Match the scan timestamp and source against the approved change record.
Check for out-of-scope targets or traffic beyond the approved window.
If the approval and scope match, document evidence and close as benign.
rationale: Registered scanner plus approved change window supports benign classification, subject to scope validation.

title: Public storage access policy modified
summary: Cloud audit shows a storage policy allowing public reads, followed by a policy status warning. Exposure of any objects remains unverified.

signals.label: Public-read policy introduced
signals.detail: Policy change added a Principal wildcard and GetObject action.

signals.label: Security control warning
signals.detail: Configuration evaluation marked public access as a concern.

signals.label: Sensitive asset classification
signals.detail: Synthetic inventory labels this reporting bucket high-impact; content access not verified.

events.summary: Storage access flagged as potentially public

mitre: T1537 Transfer Data to Cloud Account (not established)
next_steps: Review the effective bucket policy and block-public-access settings.
Check object-level access logs and sensitive-data classification.
Confirm whether the policy change was approved.
Escalate for owner review and approved remediation if exposure is confirmed.
rationale: A public-read policy on a high-impact bucket warrants prompt escalation; actual object exposure is not established.
